# gfopentls.library API headers

The public headers of gfopentls.library, API version 1, from
DalsinAI/gfopentls main (commit e9a3d22, 2 November 2026), unchanged.
MIT licensed and free, Copyright (c) 2026 AmiCradle Team (`LICENSE`).
`src/httpget.c` is built against them for https://; the library itself is
opened at run time, never linked.
